tieu_de: Embedded SW Engineer Flash Boot Loader
yeu_cau:
Your Qualifications
▪ Minimum bachelor degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
▪ 2-5 years experience in Embedded System.
▪ Embedded development tool especially Rhapsody, Polyspace, WindIdea, Davinci, DOORs, PTC…
▪ Be proficient with C programming language, firmware, bare-metal programming.
▪ Be familiar with embedded microcontroller16-/32-bit microprocessor is a plus.
▪ Write and review Software specifications, Architecture and Design documents for the system.
▪ Experience with simulation and development tools, e.g. Vector CANoe, etc
▪ Real time operating system OSEK programming experience preferred
▪ Knowledge on Communication& Diagnostic protocols: CAN, LIN, Ethernet and TCP/IP protocols and UDS.
Required Skills
▪ Knowledge and skills related to AUTOSAR, CAN, MEM, UDS, RTOS.
▪ Nice to have experience with Flash Boot Loader
▪ Good communication in English and presentation skills.
▪ Familiarity with Agile methodology is an advantage.
quyen_loi:
Friendly working environment,
Competitive Salary
Training abroad opportunities

Besides competitive salary, we also offer other compelling benefits to our employees.
 
Our building is located in the center of Ho Chi Minh city, close to the airport and within walking distance to the central downtown.
The office is modern and bright, where our employees are working in an open office environment, with spacious and comfortable working stations. They are provided with novel appliances to fulfill their tasks at their best convenience. We have meeting rooms with modern conference call system which can be used to communicate with other HELLA locations. Working here, you also have a chance to learn from our specialists from all over the world, to work with international teams and to travel to Asia and Europe.
Our company has two fully equipped pantries for our employees with modern facilities and are well taken care of. To protect our employees, in addition to public health, our employees are granted private health care with favourable conditions for them and two other dependants.
Furthermore, we take our employee's happiness as one of our most important concerns. We hold an annual outing trip to help create a friendly and cooperative relationship in the company. We also offer other outdoor activities such as providing tickets to participate in public events (Color me run, Oktoberfest, etc.), and providing a staff recreation allowance for department team building activities, etc.
